events.verdict: DeRozan (SAC) maintains a legal guarding position during WIggins' (GSW) drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Hield (GSW) jumps from point A to point B into Monk's (SAC) body, affecting his driving shot attempt.
Murray (SAC) contests Curry's (GSW) jump shot and the contact after the release, and follow-through, is marginal.
Post (GSW) makes contact to Fox's (SAC) head and affects his driving shot attempt.
Post (GSW) delivers contact to Fox (SAC) during the screen.

Replay review of the foul called on Sabonis (SAC) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Sabonis closes out to the side of Moody (GSW), who extends his leg out to initiate the marginal contact. Since the ball is loose at the point of interruption, play resumes with a jump ball.
Murray (SAC) rests a hand on Curry's (GSW) back and immediately removes it without affecting his SQBR during the driving shot attempt.
Curry (GSW) contests Monk's (SAC) driving shot attempt and any contact that occurs is marginal.
Fox (SAC) commits a take foul on Curry (GSW).
Murray (SAC) legally contests Curry's (GSW) jump shot attempt.
Hield (GSW) commits a take foul on Fox (SAC).
Murray (SAC) maintains a legal guarding position during Moody's (GSW) drive to the basket and shot attempt.
